title: How Many Disposable Cameras Do You Need for a Wedding?
description: How many disposable cameras for a wedding? The one-per-table rule, a chart for 50 to 250 guests, November 2026 costs and how many usable photos to expect.
dek: One per table is the classic rule. Here are the counts, the spares and the real costs.
excerpt: Camera counts for 50 to 250 guests, what each setup costs with developing, how many photos to expect, and the logistics that get every camera back.
primary_keyword: how many disposable cameras for wedding
secondary_keywords: how many disposable cameras to get for wedding

faq.q: How many disposable cameras do I need for 100 guests?
faq.a: About 12: one for each of 10 tables plus 2 spares. That gives you 324 exposures and, as of November 2026, costs roughly $328 to $430 with developing and scans. For a lighter sampler, 7 to 10 cameras is enough. For heavy coverage of about 5 to 7 exposures per guest, you’d need 17 to 25.

faq.q: How many pictures does a disposable camera take?
faq.a: Kodak FunSaver and Fujifilm QuickSnap cameras take 27 photos each. Some wedding-themed bulk packs hold only 17 exposures per camera, so check the listing before you buy. Expect a share of every roll to miss, from dark flash shots to accidental frames, so plan on fewer usable photos than exposures.

faq.q: Should every table get a disposable camera?
faq.a: It’s the most common setup and the easiest to manage, because each table has its own roll and a captain can look after it. If cameras on every table don’t suit your décor, put them at the busiest spots instead, such as the bar, the gift table and the kids’ table, and tell guests where to find them.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to buy disposable cameras in bulk?
faq.a: Not always. In November 2026, a Kodak FunSaver 10-pack on Walmart.com worked out to $18.81 a camera, while a Fujifilm QuickSnap two-pack sold by Walmart was $14.94 a camera. Some wedding-themed packs cost over $30 a camera with only 17 exposures. Divide the pack price by the number of cameras, then by exposures.

faq.q: How many disposable cameras for a 200-person wedding?
faq.a: About 23: 20 tables of 10 plus 3 spares, for 621 exposures. At November 2026 prices that’s roughly $624 to $824 with developing. A shared camera app can cover the same guest list for far less: Filmsera’s Wedding pass, a one-time purchase, is $49.99 for up to 250 guests at the time of writing.
